evidence.locator: PDF pp11–14, Figure7 pp12, Clinical evaluation p23

genotype.statement: Homozygous GAS2 c.723+1G>A is explicit in all four affected siblings; source NM_005256.3 and GRCh37 g.22777500G>A differ from packet NM_001143830.3 and GRCh38 g.22755954G>A.

evidence.locator: PDF pp11–14, Figure7 pp12, Clinical evaluation p23

limitations: Transcript/assembly equivalence not independently normalized; protein p.? is consistent with source.

segregation.statement: Four affected siblings homozygous, both unaffected consanguineous parents heterozygous, V.3/V.4 wild type; Sanger confirmation and pedigree agree.

evidence.locator: PDF pp11–14, Figure7 pp12, Clinical evaluation p23

phase.statement: Homozygous state with heterozygous parents establishes the recessive segregation; no two distinct variants requiring compound phase.

evidence.locator: PDF pp11–14, Figure7 pp12, Clinical evaluation p23

causal_confidence.statement: Source argues causality from segregating splice disruption, intron6 retention in V.5 cells and knockout mouse phenotype. Formal packet PATHOGENIC/SOLVED and later OMIM disease number exceed explicit classification in source.

evidence.locator: PDF pp11–14, Figure7 pp12, Clinical evaluation p23

limitations: One family; co-segregating compound-heterozygous TMPRSS4 variants discounted by authors on expression/function grounds; no human GAS2 protein truncation directly demonstrated.

limitations: V.5 packet omits normal vestibular testing; unread TableS2 prevents exhaustive audiological comparison.
